about: The PQ companion of a CaEndorsement lease (packages/protocol/src/caLeasePq.ts): flagship/ca-lease/v2|<endorsementId>|<sha256(v1)>|<signedBy>|<keyId>, hybrid-signed under the ca-track holder's release-key binding (subject flagship-ca-track). With a non-empty pin a lease counts only with a verified companion unless its v1 digest is in legacyLeases. Each case lists the endorsementIds that must be accepted, in order.

cases.name: pinned: both leases with their companions
pinned: a lease whose companion was stripped
pinned: the companions without the binding
pinned: a companion moved to another lease
pinned: a binding for another purpose
pinned: another key in the pin
pinned: a lease signed before the cut-over
